entities.summary: Samuel Chatto is a British ceramic artist and relative of the British royal family. Born in London to Lady Sarah Chatto and Daniel Chatto, both of whom are artists, he is a grandson of Princess Margaret, Countess of Snowdon and a grand-nephew of Elizabeth II. As of November 2025, he is 30th in line to the British throne. He also has a younger brother, Arthur, with whom he attended Eton College.
